2607.04508.title: Compressing the Validation Bottleneck: An Agentic Self-Driving Lab for Scientific Discovery
2607.04508.paper_summary: Agentic AI-for-Science can automate ideation, planning, and analysis, but final validation still depends on real experiments. A self-driving lab (SDL) can execute those experiments, yet the loop still has bottlenecks: the agent may spend too many rounds on low-value experiments, or each round may require a high-cost experiment. We target these two physical bottlenecks with one agent. First, a prior-aware agentic DOE loop uses domain knowledge and past results to propose feasible and informative next experiments, reducing trials-to-target. Second, a cost-aware surrogate agent predicts high-cost, high-resolution measurements from low-cost, low-resolution measurements. It chooses between a high- and a low-cost measurement based on the predicted uncertainty. We examine these directions in the biology and materials domains, respectively. Together, under a single agent, these components aim to accelerate the SDL loop by reducing both the number of loops and the cost per experiment.
2607.04508.paper_summary_zh: 代理AI科學應用可以自動化構思、規劃和分析，但最終的驗證仍然依賴於實際實驗。自駕實驗室（SDL）可以執行這些實驗，但這個循環仍然有瓶頸：代理可能在低價值實驗上花費太多輪次，或者每一輪可能需要高成本的實驗。我們針對這兩個物理瓶頸使用一個代理。首先，具備先前知識的代理DOE循環利用領域知識和過去結果來提出可行且具信息性的下一步實驗，從而減少達成目標所需的試驗次數。其次，具備成本意識的代理預測高成本、高解析度的測量，並從低成本、低解析度的測量中獲得。它根據預測的不確定性在高成本和低成本的測量之間進行選擇。我們分別在生物學和材料領域檢視這些方向。總體而言，在單一代理的協調下，這些組件旨在通過減少循環次數和每次實驗的成本來加速SDL循環。
2607.04508.author: Kyunghoon Hur et.al.
